g.text: Pi-Gen imaging: first boot on a personalized node (systemd ordering)
eth0 = NODE_IP/24, no gateway, no DNS,
start ONLY if already in this boot transaction
FINDING (verify on hardware): systemd computes the boot transaction before
firstboot runs. Units that firstboot newly enables (slurmctld/slurmd, k3s,
ivalice-postboot-ansible, all WantedBy=multi-user.target) normally do not
start until the NEXT boot, unless something calls systemctl start. Expect a
second power cycle before Slurm and Ansible convergence run.
